name: files.completeUploadExternal
purpose: Finishes an upload started with files.getUploadURLExternal

files.desc: Array of file ids and their corresponding (optional) titles.

channel_id.desc: Channel ID where the file will be shared. If not specified the file will be private.

thread_ts.desc: Provide another message's ts value to upload this file as a reply. Never use a reply's ts value; use its parent instead. Also make sure to provide only one channel when using 'thread_ts'.

channels.desc: Comma-separated string of channel IDs or user IDs where the file will be shared.

initial_comment.desc: The message text introducing the file in specified channels.

blocks.desc: A JSON-based array of structured rich text blocks, presented as a URL-encoded string. If the initial_comment field is provided, the blocks field is ignored.

username.desc: Set your bot's user name for the file share message. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.

icon_url.desc: URL to an image to use as the icon for the file share message. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.

icon_emoji.desc: Emoji to use as the icon for the file share message. Overrides icon_url. Requires the chat:write.customize scope.

safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true. 'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.
